name: Roland V-Synth
description: Roland V-Synth (2003) elastic-audio synthesizer: the setup and system blocks and Part 1's temporary patch — common, MFX, chorus, reverb, controller, sixteen zones of oscillators, envelopes, LFOs and two COSMs, and sixteen arpeggio notes — from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: V-Synth MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Nov. 20, 2002)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from V-SYNTH_OM.pdf (sha256 5ebb92ba7005cb7204eb242c1b82620e7fa96e182fb5f5c7baa276a59788c818). Model ID 00 53, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Part 1 is the patch played from the keyboard; in multitimbral use parts 2-16 each hold a temporary patch of their own (10 01 00 00 - 10 0F 00 00), not laid out.
Printed names kept as printed: "Sustine" for Sustain (Patch Envelope, all thirteen envelopes: zone1.env.env1Sustine …).
The scale-tune message the manual prints after the examples (address 40 1x 40) is a GS-format DT1 (model ID 42H), outside this address map.

Identity: the V-Synth (owner's manual p158) and the V-Synth XT (its MIDI Implementation p6) print the same Identity Reply, F0 7E dev 06 02 41 53 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 F7 — family code 53 01, family number 00 00, revision 00 01 00 00 — and the same model ID, 00 53. Nothing in the reply tells them apart, so either profile matches either instrument; the XT's address map has three blocks this one has not (System Controller 2 (XT), Patch Controller 2 (XT), Patch Step Modulator).

The address map is the V-Synth XT's less those three blocks, with a reserved byte at Patch Common 00 0C (the XT's Patch Category), Patch Oscillator ending at 00 78 (00 00 00 79; the XT adds a detune and a sub-oscillator per OSC), Analog Waveform 0 - 8, Matrix Control Dest 0 - 77 and COSM Type 0 - 15 (the XT: 0 - 13, 0 - 78, 0 - 16).

p169 <Example2> computes the RQ1 for PATCH MFX of PATCH:003 and writes "117 (sum) ÷ 128" for a sum it has just given as 41; its message, F0 41 10 00 53 11 20 02 02 00 00 00 01 04 57 F7, agrees with the map. p170 <Example4> calls the last part "Temporary Patch (Port 16)".

The Receive Data section (p153) says channel messages are "Not received in Multitimbre mode or Performance mode when the Receive Switch parameter (MULTITIMBRE/MIDI or PERFORM/MIDI) is OFF"; the V-Synth has neither mode, and its receive switches are System Common's Part 1-16 Receive Switch (00 0C - 00 2A).

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the D Beam, Time Trip Pad, knobs and pedals transmit (Data Transmission, p157-158) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: Part 1's Temporary Patch (10 00 00 00), whole: every zone, every arpeggio note. Parts 2-16's are not laid out: Temporary Patch (Part n) is at 10 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 01 00 00 (10 01 00 00 … 10 0F 00 00), each the same blocks at the same offsets. Each part's bank and program (Setup) and receive switch and channel (System Common) are laid out
coverage.memories: not laid out: User Patch 001-512 (20 00 00 00 - 23 7F 00 00), memory rather than edit buffer
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus, reverb and COSM parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
